subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` as a new public config key, and if so should it apply to both embedded and local compaction while Codex-native compaction only warns?
rationale: This is a user-facing config/default addition in an area where the repo policy sets a high bar, and the permanent scope cannot be inferred safely from the patch alone.

options.title: Accept and repair full local coverage
options.body: Accept the new key, wire it through local manual and auto compaction, keep the Codex-native warning, and require focused proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the public scope
options.body: Allow the key only for embedded compaction and make local/Codex-native limitations explicit in help/docs before considering merge.

options.title: Fold into broader per-agent overrides
options.body: Pause or close this focused PR if maintainers want the behavior to land only as part of the broader per-agent compaction override direction.

recommendation.title: Accept and repair full local coverage
recommendation.body: Accept the new key, wire it through local manual and auto compaction, keep the Codex-native warning, and require focused proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to @jalehman and his listed/current history is closest to compaction and context-engine direction.
